stories.title: L'Ue gela Roma: "Abbiamo già dato più flessibilità". Ricevuta la lettera di Meloni

en.title: The EU freezes Rome: "We have already given more flexibility". Meloni's letter received
en.summary: A European Commission spokesperson responded to Italian Prime Minister Meloni's letter to Ursula von der Leyen, stating that the EU has already provided additional flexibility on budgetary matters.

stories.title: Dalla testata a Materazzi a ct della Francia: Zidane incrocia ancora l’Italia

en.title: From the headbutt to Materazzi to France coach: Zidane crosses Italy again
en.summary: Twenty years after Italy's 2006 World Cup victory, Zinedine Zidane's debut as France's coach is set to occur against the Italian national team.

stories.title: Benigni da Vespa: “San Francesco, un ottimo leader del campo largo”

en.title: Benigni on Vespa: "Saint Francis, an excellent leader of the broad left"
en.summary: Academy Award winner Benigni appeared on the program Cinque Minuti to discuss a monologue about Saint Francis of Assisi scheduled to air on RAI 1 on October 4.

stories.title: Benigni, 'San Francesco potrebbe essere stato un ottimo leader del Campo Largo'

en.title: Benigni, 'Saint Francis could have been an excellent leader of the Broad Left'
en.summary: Appearing on Vespa's Cinque Minuti program, Benigni discussed Saint Francis as someone deserving of love for his proclamation of equality before God.

stories.title: Putin, 'le esercitazioni occidentali nel Mar Baltico sono un'escalation'

en.title: Putin: 'Western exercises in the Baltic Sea are an escalation'
en.summary: Putin characterized Western military exercises in the Baltic Sea as an escalation and referenced attempts to stop Russian ships in the region.

stories.title: Zidane: “La testata a Materazzi? Non ne vado fiero, ma non ho rimpianti”

en.title: Zidane: 'The headbutt on Materazzi? I'm not proud of it, but I have no regrets'
en.summary: Two decades after retiring as a player, Zidane reflected on his infamous headbutt incident while preparing to face Italy in his first match as France's coach.

stories.title: C’è la Francia di Zidane per l’Italia. Mancini: “Questa partita ci dirà molte cose”

en.title: France under Zidane awaits Italy. Mancini: 'This match will tell us a lot'
en.summary: Italy faces France in Paris for a crucial group-stage fixture. The Italian coach expressed confidence ahead of the challenging encounter against the European powerhouse.

stories.title: Draghi: “L’Europa metta al centro la crescita. No a tassi troppo alti”

en.title: Draghi: 'Europe must prioritize growth. No to excessively high rates'
en.summary: The former ECB president warned that fiscal discipline alone is insufficient for debt sustainability and called for economic development, urging European policymakers to maintain a common agenda while cautioning against interest rates that could weaken the economy.

stories.title: Salone Nautico, al taglio del nastro solo Meloni e Bucci, esclusa Salis. E la premier le telefona

en.title: Boat Show, only Meloni and Bucci at ribbon-cutting, Salis excluded. And the premier calls her
en.summary: At the opening of a boat show, the mayor was excluded from the ribbon-cutting ceremony while the prime minister and another official attended. The prime minister later called the mayor to protest the organizers' decision.

stories.title: Usa, la Corte Suprema dà il via libera all’esecuzione di Christa Pike, ma lei sopravvive a due iniezioni. Ricoverata in ospedale

en.title: USA, Supreme Court clears way for execution of Christa Pike, but she survives two injections. Hospitalized
en.summary: The U.S. Supreme Court authorized the execution of a 50-year-old woman convicted for a crime committed as a teenager, but she survived two injection attempts and was hospitalized. The state governor subsequently suspended her death sentence.

stories.title: Guerra Ucraina - Russia. Putin: “Esercitazioni dell’Occidente nel Baltico sono escalation”

en.title: Ukraine-Russia War. Putin: "Western exercises in the Baltic are escalation"
en.summary: Russia's president characterized NATO exercises in the Baltic as escalatory and suggested a military response would follow. Russian drones struck a significant bridge in Kyiv while the EU condemned Moscow's nuclear rhetoric.

stories.title: Putin all’Occidente: “Le esercitazioni nel Mar Baltico sono un’escalation, risponderemo”

en.title: Putin to the West: "Exercises in the Baltic Sea are an escalation, we will respond"
en.summary: Russia's president rejected a proposal to suspend long-range strikes between Russia and Ukraine, characterizing Western military exercises in the Baltic as escalatory and indicating Russia would respond.

stories.title: Rai, sui conti l’incognita Rai Way Obiettivo pareggio alla fine del 2026

en.title: Rai, accounting uncertainty on Rai Way Goal break-even by end of 2026
en.summary: The Italian broadcaster's group accounts returned to losses, though management expects to reach break-even by the end of 2026. Revenue projections worsened compared to earlier targets during the year.

stories.title: «Attrattivi per la qualità del nostro ecosistema»

en.title: «Attractive for the quality of our ecosystem»
en.summary: Barbara Cimmino from Confindustria comments on the results of the first Foreign Companies Barometer, noting both positive findings and areas requiring attention.

stories.title: Imprese estere, fiducia più alta nei servizi. Pesa l’incertezza

en.title: Foreign companies, higher confidence in services. Uncertainty weighs
en.summary: Confindustria's first barometer measured in August the expectations of internationally-controlled companies operating in three sectors, finding stronger confidence in the services industry.

stories.title: Via al Salone dell’eccellenza nautica, in ripresa anche i piccoli cantieri

en.title: Launch of the Nautical Excellence Showcase, small shipyards also recovering
en.summary: The Genoa nautical show is opening with aspirations to become the world's leading boat exhibition, while smaller shipyard operators report recovery.

en.title: Ambienta bets on Norwegian aquaculture
en.summary: Ambienta Sgr, an investment firm founded by Nino Tronchetti Provera focused on sustainability, has acquired Norwegian aquaculture companies BioMarine, Flatsetsund Engineering, and Smir through its Ambienta IV fund.
